claims.statement: Existing CEIDG firms registered by the end of 2024 must have an e-Delivery address from 1 October 2026; missed or mishandled official correspondence creates measurable staff time and deadline risk.
The public provider offers a free inbox, so a paid service must monetize triage, accountability and workflow rather than mailbox access.

commercial_mechanics.budget_owner: SME owner, office manager or accounting-firm partner
commercial_mechanics.bundling_resistance: The service sells response ownership, deadline extraction and evidence trails across many client entities, not a duplicate mailbox.
commercial_mechanics.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own SME or accounting-firm subscriptions; the public provider retains mailbox infrastructure.
commercial_mechanics.distribution_origin: Accounting firms distribute a multi-entity triage service to existing clients.

fully_loaded_economics.acquisition_cost: Assumption: 300-800 PLN per SME through accountants.
fully_loaded_economics.delivery_and_support_costs: Shared analyst handles exceptions; 10-20 minutes per active entity monthly assumed.
fully_loaded_economics.overhead_and_compliance: Security, processor agreements, insurance and audit logging estimated at 12,000 PLN monthly.
fully_loaded_economics.variable_costs: Document parsing, secure storage, notifications and analyst escalation.

commercial_mechanics.likely_incumbent_response: Accounting suites may bundle inbox alerts; defend with multi-provider workflows and accountable escalation SLAs.
commercial_mechanics.paid_event_or_measurable_loss: SME pays monthly to ensure official messages are triaged and assigned before deadlines; measurable loss is staff handling time or a missed response.
commercial_mechanics.purchase_trigger: Mandatory activation, first confusing official message or accountant managing many entities.
commercial_mechanics.renewal_event: Monthly while the entity maintains official correspondence.

contrary_evidence: The government mailbox is free and supports administrator delegation.
A 2026 legislative proposal would remove some outbound-use obligations, creating scope uncertainty.

critical_control_point.acquisition_instrument: Unknown; proposed mailbox authorization and accounting-firm distribution agreements are unsigned.
critical_control_point.counterparty_refusal_fallback: Provide secure user-forwarding and checklist triage without direct mailbox integration; sell directly to multi-entity owners.
critical_control_point.current_owner: The public or qualified provider controls mailbox infrastructure; each enterprise controls administrator access.
critical_control_point.customer_relationship_owner: The prospective business would own SME or accounting-firm subscriptions; the public provider retains mailbox infrastructure.
critical_control_point.duration: Unknown until authorization and subscriptions are signed.
critical_control_point.founder_access_description: No existing mailbox access or accounting distribution rights.
critical_control_point.launch_controller: The founder would control triage and audit workflow; customers control authorization and official responses.
critical_control_point.renewal: Unknown; proposed monthly subscription and revocable mailbox authorization.
critical_control_point.subject: Official-message triage workflow

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot forwarded-message triage for 30 entities through one accountant, then seek formal provider integrations.
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Assumption: 8,000 entities at 79 PLN monthly creates 7.6M PLN ARR; at 20% owner earnings and 4x ARR, a 70% stake exceeds 5M PLN in years 6-9. Accountant channel economics and support load are unknown.
economics.founder_time: 12-18 hours weekly; analyst coverage required before SLA promises.
economics.gross_margin_basis: Subscription less parsing, secure delivery and direct analyst escalation; target 70%.
economics.payback: Target SME payback from under one hour saved monthly or one avoided missed deadline; channel CAC payback under six months.
economics.pricing: 49-149 PLN per entity monthly; accountant portfolio discounts.

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Permissioned document-type and resolution playbooks improve routing.
fingerprint.customer: Polish SMEs and accounting firms managing many legal entities.
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: SME pays monthly around receipt and handling of official correspondence.
fingerprint.problem_trigger: Mandatory inbox activation or a missed-message scare.

risks: Free mailbox and administrator tools may be sufficient.
Sensitive official correspondence raises severe security liability.
thesis: Monetize accountable handling rather than free mailbox access by owning the triage-to-assignee workflow for SMEs and accountants.
title: e-Delivery Inbox Operations
uncertainties: Liability and support cost per entity
